history.summary: A 710sqft 1BR at $880k / $1,239 PSF in D18 Pasir Ris, priced ~4% below the $1,289 URA median on a very reliable 114-txn 3.70% CAGR. Low entry price and strong data, but it is 1.25km from the nearest (future CRL) station and OCR appreciation is modest.
history.rating_rationale: The 3.70% rate is backed by an excellent 114-transaction sample (high confidence) and the ~4% discount to median plus sub-$900k price keep it liquid. But 1.25km to the still-future CR4 Pasir Ris East station is a poor walk, OCR appreciation here is baseline-grade, and a 1BR has the narrowest tenant pool. The CRL (2030) opening is the swing factor — without proximity benefit it stays a steady, unexciting hold.
red_flags: 1.25km / 15-min walk to MRT, and that station is the not-yet-open CRL
catalysts: Reliable 3.70% rate on 114 txns; ~4% below median
CRL Pasir Ris East (~2030) area uplift
Sub-$900k entry, near beach/Pasir Ris Park lifestyle

history.summary: Large 710 sqft 1BR in a 2014 Pasir Ris condo, asking $1,239 psf vs verified $1,185-1,389 psf (avg $1,284) over the last 12 months — genuinely at the bottom of the recent range. OCR/D18 region is the strongest forward-appreciation bucket, and the upcoming Cross Island Line adds a real catalyst.
history.rating_rationale: The cheapness here is verifiable: recent Seastrand transactions ran $1,185-1,389 psf (avg $1,284) and this unit asks $1,239 psf — a real ~3-4% discount to the trailing average, consistent with the algo's -16.9% age-adjusted signal and -3.2% cohort read. A 710 sqft 1BR is unusually large/livable for the type, supporting both rental and resale demand. D18 is the top realized forward-appreciation region (~+4%). The Cross Island Line (Pasir Ris East / Loyang stations) is a dated, decisive catalyst for the Pasir Ris locale. Confidence held at medium because psf_cohort_txns=0 means the exact-size comp is thin and the appreciation read (3.7% CAGR) is unremarkable.
red_flags: psf_cohort_txns=0 — no exact same-size comparable, so the -3.2% cohort premium is unverified at the unit level
99-year leasehold from 2011 (~84yr left) — fine now but a long-run consideration
Pasir Ris is a far-east locale; reviews note very windy NS-facing stacks with no afternoon sun
catalysts: Cross Island Line — Pasir Ris East (CR4) / Loyang (CR3) stations improving connectivity
Pasir Ris Central redevelopment and integrated transport/retail hub
OCR/D18 is the strongest realized forward-appreciation region (~+4%)
Verified asking PSF at the bottom of the recent transaction range
